item.stem:
Ira looks at the diagram. Points $B$ and $C$ are fixed. She needs every point that is $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ from $B$ and also $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ from $C$.

Which claim correctly locates those points?

options.A: They are the intersection points of the circle of radius $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ centered at $B$ with the circle of radius $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ centered at $C$.
options.B: Call the answer the single label midpoint of $BC$.
options.C: Say that the finished intersection points are what create the equal $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ distances.
options.D: Choose the points only because the printed $5$ is the largest number on the page.
